exposure: excision of full-thickness infiltration of urinary bladder
cohort: A single 46-year-old woman with a history of severe endometriosis and adenomyosis who developed an oligosymptomatic vesicovaginal fistula as a complication of surgery.
finding: The patient's oligosymptomatic vesicovaginal fistula closed after 6 weeks following treatment with platelet-rich plasma (PRP) injections, demonstrating the potential of this conservative treatment modality.
